simple.meaning: יַחְלְאֵל (Yachlᵉʼêl) is a Hebrew word meaning “Jachleel , an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יַחְלְאֵל (H3177) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 46:14, with occurrences in Genesis, Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יַחְלְאֵל (H3177) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יַחְלְאֵל (H3177) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יַחְלְאֵל (Yachlᵉʼêl) / H3177 is traced through Genesis 46:14, Numbers 26:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
